dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body mass initiated from the mid-dorsal peak toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Distinct asymmetrical lateral expansion (bulge) on the left margin relative to the more uniform convex curvature of the right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity with a significant blue-spectrum ambient light bias across the entire visible surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Thin, low-contrast white linear mark located on the mid-dorsal plane, oriented longitudinally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a faint, linear epidermal scar or rake mark on the central dorsal region.
